title: 応募は公式リウマート

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh! A campaign to give away official Uma pics, eh? I gotta repost this ASA—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-this can't be… How did I, of all people, fail to notice something on Umatter that's been reposted 1,254 times?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Groan. Reposting now won't do a thing besides being a huge humiliation to my Umas…
